description: Use when the user asks for a court decision or case law (EU Court of Justice, Dutch, French, German or UK courts) by case name, subject, case number or ECLI and needs the official link. Find court decisions with official links and identifiers (ECLI, case number), no legal advice. EU: Court of Justice and General Court (CELLAR) by words from the case name or subject, case number (C-131/12, T-604/18) or ECLI; links to EUR-Lex and CURIA. NL: decision metadata and links by ECLI (Rechtspraak open data); text queries return the rechtspraak.nl search link. FR: Cour de cassation decisions (JUDILIBRE) by keywords or JUDILIBRE id. DE: federal court decisions (Rechtsinformationsportal des Bundes, trial API) by keywords, file number or ECLI; links to rechtsprechung-im-internet.de. GB: Find Case Law search link only. Free, read-only.

jurisdiction.description: EU (default; CJEU and General Court), NL, FR, DE or GB (UK, link only). Codes or names in any language. An ECLI sets it automatically.

query.description: Words from the case name or subject ('Google Spain', 'right to be forgotten'), a case number (C-131/12), an ECLI (ECLI:EU:C:2014:317, ECLI:NL:HR:2019:2006) or a file number (DE: '2 AZR 797/11').
